items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: all I should say a blue shirt for parade, and a white top or a cap and a black pants and black shoes. The guys come out with tans, shoes, and they come with a gray pants, they don't look nice, you know what I mean? They don't, it looks raggedy, you know, like, but if all the guys had, that's what I'

ctx.x: Would they wear the same cap for parade or they'd wear for a funeral, for example? Yeah, they did.

I mean, they didn't like today, I mean, you see. They'd wear the dog caps, you see me. Same uniform. But today, you see, they wear a white cap for parade and for a funeral, they wear a dog cap today, you see me. But the guys haven't got no uniform. I haven't got guys come up with blue pants or something. Anyway, if they had a black pants and a white shirt or even a blue shirt, and all I should say a blue shirt for parade, and a white top or a cap and a black pants and black shoes. The guys come out with tans,…

Paul Barberin, March 27, 1957, reel 2. Was there any braid on the trousers or was it just on the colors? No, it was on the side. On the side, like a tuxedo. Yeah, I like a tuxedo, that's right. It was really nice.
